properties.message_511: On I-95 at mile marker 90.6 in the County of Hanover, motorists can expect delays due to a vehicle crash. The north right shoulder is closed.
On I-95 at mile marker 71.5 in the County of Chesterfield, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The south right shoulder is closed.
On I-64 at mile marker 275 in the City of Norfolk, near Bay Avenue, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The east right shoulder is closed.
